controls.description: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.
Internal communication channels support the functioning of internal control.
Controls are selected and developed that mitigate risks to acceptable levels.
Logical access security measures restrict access to authorized users.
The entity implements boundary protection systems to prevent unauthorized access.
The entity monitors system components for anomalies indicative of security events.
The entity maintains, monitors, and evaluates current processing capacity.
Environmental protections, backup, and recovery infrastructure are implemented.
System processing is complete, accurate, timely, and authorized.
Confidential information is protected during collection, use, and retention.
Confidential information is disposed of securely once no longer required.
Personal information is collected consistent with the entity's privacy notice.
Explicit consent is obtained before personal information is used for new purposes.
Personal information is disclosed only to authorized third parties.
